en: Colorized vintage view of a tranquil waterway labeled as the Mahmoudieh Canal in Alexandria. The canal runs through a flat landscape with palm trees and low vegetation along the banks. A few animals, including donkeys or horses, stand near the water's edge and on a small stone quay in the foreground. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors, suggesting either sunrise or sunset. The website address 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.
